The whole K-means recipe

Remember: Pick, Put, Push!

K is the number of teams. Here, K = 2. The computer repeats these three small jobs until nothing needs to move.

  1. 1
    Pick

    Pick 2 starting middles.

  2. 2
    Put

    Put every dot with its nearest middle.

  3. 3
    Push

    Push each middle to the team’s average.

This is a learning demo with pretend customer data. It shows K-means clustering, not a real decision about a person.
